mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. Have you ever wondered what happens when someone born into privilege dares to question—and even overturn—the very system that gave them everything? Together, we’re about to step into a world where tradition and status usually dictate the rules, and few expect those at the top to rewrite them. But that’s exactly what makes the story of Franklin Delano Roosevelt so intriguing. In H.W. Brands’ remarkable book, Traitor to His Class, we get to follow Roosevelt’s journey—from his golden childhood, surrounded by comfort and expectation, to the moments when he risked it all to stand with everyday Americans during the darkest days of the Great Depression. What made a man born into wealth decide to champion the common good? We’ll explore how Roosevelt’s inner transformation, and his willingness to defy his own class, not only changed the course of his life, but reshaped the destiny of a nation teetering on the edge. As we dig into this story, you’ll see how his bold New Deal policies, his sharp political instincts, and his ability to inspire hope brought America through crisis and into a new era. So, let’s set out together—ready to discover how personal conviction, empathy, and a touch of rebellion can change everything. Here’s to uncovering the legacy of a leader whose courage continues to echo through history.
